values.note: Whitewater Township 2026: $55 a night May 22 - Sept 7, $45 Sept 8 - Oct 25 (one rate for every site; no resident/non-resident split posted). RoverPass's service and card-processing fees are added at checkout and are non-refundable.

fees.source: https://whitewatertownshippark.org/ ('May 22 – Sept. 7 : $55 per night', 'Sept. 8 – Oct 25 : $45 per night') + refund policy ('All refund calculations exclude the RoverPass service fees and credit card processing'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 2026 season May 8 - Oct 25; RoverPass shows the park closed Oct 26 - May 7 in each of the next three years.

season.source: https://whitewatertownshippark.org/ ('Open May 8 to Oct. 25, 2026'; 'Oct. 26 – Campground Closed') + RoverPass park record closeSeasonDates (2026-10-26 to 2027-05-07, 2027-10-26 to 2028-05-07), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://whitewatertownshippark.org/ ('Sites 20-42 are 50 amp, all other sites are 30 amp') + the 2026 site-description PDF, read 2026-10-25

values.note: Sites 23, 40, 54 and 55 are pull-throughs; sites 3, 10, 31 and 33 are marked 'Tent or small RV'. Site depths run 28 to 105 ft (most 40-60 ft); no maximum rig length is posted.

sites.source: https://whitewatertownshippark.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Campground-Map-and-Site-Descriptions-2026.pdf (per-site amps, width, depth, notes) + https://whitewatertownshippark.org/ ('55 Campsites for Tents and RVs'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://whitewatertownshippark.org/ (Amenities: Boat Launch, Tent and RV Sites, Bath House, Sandy Beach, Dump Station, Nature Trails, Firewood for Sale), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked on RoverPass (the website's reservation link; a claimed, bookable listing), up to 6 months ahead. Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, the 4th of July, Labor Day) need 3 nights. From Memorial Day to Labor Day stays are limited to 14 consecutive days, then 7 days must pass before another booking. Must be 18 to reserve; six people per site.

booking.source: https://whitewatertownshippark.org/ ('The holiday weekend minimum is 3 nights. Holiday weekends include Memorial Day, the 4th of July, and Labor Day.') + RoverPass park record (isBookable true, advancedMonths 6; policy: 'from Memorial Day to Labor Day there is a 14 consecutive days limit, you will not be able to book another reservation for at least 7 days'), read 2026-10-25

note: Whitewater Township park on Elk Lake near Williamsburg/Elk Rapids, with a sandy beach, boat launch and about 2 miles of nature trails. Operator: Whitewater Township (camping@whitewatertownshipmi.gov). --Claude
